the user interface for ambient intelligence is a combination of the physical and the digital, that this combination is a new form of interaction and communication, and that it has to be designed to be intuitive and easy to use, to be fun and playful, and to be aesthetically pleasing.

the design of user interfaces and interaction techniques for ambient environments is an interdisciplinary endeavor, and that a user-centered design approach is crucial to the success of such environments.

the development of user interfaces and Human Computer Interaction for Ambient Intelligence and smart environments.
